Trump's Reaction to B-1 Bombers During Xi Jinping's Welcome Noted

During the welcome for Chinese President Xi Jinping in the US, two B-1 bombers flew overhead as part of a military display. The bombers are noted for producing a loud roar. US President Donald Trump was observed to duck and wince as the aircraft passed. The event included a 100-foot-long red carpet and a military flyover.
